about: A JavaScript library that works out the browser, device and system from a user agent string.

prs.title: Current UC Browser on Android is detected again
prs.broken: UC Browser for Android now uses a new name in its user agent, so the library no longer recognized it.
prs.changed: The library now reads the new name as well as the old one.
prs.matters: Sites that report browser use count these visitors correctly.
